slices.focus: A lot has been shifting lately, and one thing that really bubbled up was co-pare
slices.summary: Leah's high school tours trigger reactive texting and sharp exchanges between Monica and Travis over transportation and activity fees; Monica creates a shared spreadsheet and Sunday check-in system that lowers weekday volatility and transforms co-parenting from ad-hoc conflict to reliable coordination.

decisions: Monica and Travis now use a shared spreadsheet and scheduled Sunday check-ins to handle school planning and reduce react
